name: adult brass dragon
desc: Adult Brass Dragon is a CR 13 dragon.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item Rend]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) [[/item Sleep Breath]] or (B) [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplScorchingR]{Scorching Ray}.

actions.name: fire breath
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=bDqgmtLG3zcVuqdi]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=bDqgmtLG3zcVuqdi]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=bDqgmtLG3zcVuqdi]]-foot-long, [[lookup @target.template.width activity=bDqgmtLG3zcVuqdi]]-foot-wide Line. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: sleep breath
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=6ce9oevQRWomSVSF]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=6ce9oevQRWomSVSF]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=6ce9oevQRWomSVSF]]-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the &Reference[Unconscious apply=false] condition for [[lookup @duration.value activity=EZma0lCmQeTuVuAL]] minutes. This effect ends for the target if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMinorIllus]{Minor Illusion}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplScorchingR]{Scorching Ray}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShapechang]{Shapechange} (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSpeakwithA]{Speak with Animals} 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectThou]{Detect Thoughts}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplControlWea]{Control Weather}

actions.name: blazing light
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplScorchingR]{Scorching Ray}.

actions.name: pounce
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item Rend]] attack.

actions.name: scorching sands
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=g5fxAWhrpwohtETl]], [[lookup @target.affects.labels.statblock activity=g5fxAWhrpwohtETl]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=g5fxAWhrpwohtETl]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target's Speed is halved until the end of its next turn. Failure or Success: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
